description: Read-only. List the Skill Harbor practical guides: what AI skills are, how to find, install, check and make them, and how to ship your own. Use it when the user asks how to do something on Skill Harbor, how to make, share or ship a skill, or wants a how-to guide — no search query needed. Returns every guide with its title and one-sentence summary in English and French, plus the English and French page URLs. Read the guide page itself for the full text; this tool returns metadata and links only, never the full guide.
name: get_guides
